sentences.en: During the vacation, I read the entire works of Milton.
sentences.zh: 假期里，我读完了弥尔顿的所有作品。

sentences.en: Let's take advantage of the vacation to mow the lawn.
sentences.zh: 趁着假期我们把草坪修剪一下吧。

sentences.en: The students were all looking forward to the summer vacation.
sentences.zh: 学生们都盼望着暑假的到来。
